_README: Optional manual search aliases: company name -> extra search terms.
Acronyms are derived automatically for names of 4+ significant words
(SIDBI, MUDRA, NABARD fall out with no entry here), so only add a name
when the automatic rules cannot produce it: a compressed brand name, a
ticker, or a former name the press still uses.
Keys must match the company text in team.json exactly (case-insensitive).
